title: Grade 3 English: DepEd Curriculum
description: Reading comprehension, parts of speech, sentence types, and vocabulary in context.

items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The hardworking farmer watered his crops every morning.' What is the adjective in this sentence?
items.explanation: 'Hardworking' is the adjective that describes the noun 'farmer'.

items.prompt: Which of the following is a proper noun that should always begin with a capital letter?
items.explanation: 'Manila' is the specific name of a capital city, making it a proper noun that requires capitalization.

items.prompt: Choose the correct verb form to complete the sentence: 'Maxine and Milo ___ to the library yesterday.'
items.explanation: 'Yesterday' signals past tense, requiring the past-tense verb 'walked'.

items.prompt: What type of sentence is this: 'Please pass the basket of fresh mangoes.'?
items.explanation: A polite request is an imperative sentence.

items.prompt: What is the plural form of the irregular noun 'child'?
items.explanation: The irregular plural form of 'child' is 'children'.

items.prompt: Which pronoun correctly replaces the underlined words: '<u>The students</u> finished their reading project.'?
items.explanation: 'They' is the third-person plural subject pronoun for 'The students'.

items.prompt: What is the antonym (opposite) of the word 'generous'?
items.explanation: The opposite of generous (giving freely) is selfish (unwilling to share).

items.prompt: Identify the cause in this sentence: 'Because it rained heavily, the school trip was postponed.'
items.explanation: The reason why the event happened (the cause) is 'Because it rained heavily'.

items.prompt: Which word has a prefix that means 'not'?
What punctuation mark belongs at the end of this sentence: 'What an exciting wildlife adventure this is'?
items.explanation: A sentence that shows strong feeling ends with an exclamation point.
